name: montevideo-world
description: Montevideo World — MMORPG web 2.5D isométrico (v1 prueba de concepto)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @montevideo-world/server && npm run build -w @montevideo-world/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @montevideo-world/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @montevideo-world/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @montevideo-world/server && npm run typecheck -w @montevideo-world/client
